description:
Convert the production extensions in apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extensions/ from the old per-event-callback macro shape (use OctoPi.Coder.Extension with separate handle_session_start/2, handle_agent_start/2, etc.) to PR #5's single on_event/3 callback.

## Deliverable

Each existing extension follows this shape:

```elixir
defmodule OctoPi.Coder.Extensions.Foo do
  @behaviour OctoPi.Coder.Extension
  alias OctoPi.Coder.Extension.{Host, UI}

  @impl true
  def on_event(:session_start, _payload, ctx), do: ...
  def on_event(:agent_start, _payload, ctx), do: ...
  def on_event(_, _, _), do: :ok
end
```

## Steps

STEP 1 — Enumerate target extensions:
  tools.ex, git_checkpoint.ex, dynamic_tools.ex, permission_gate.ex, auto_commit_on_exit.ex, trigger_compact.ex, session_name.ex, message_renderer.ex, commands.ex, custom_footer.ex, status_line.ex, custom_header.ex, protected_paths.ex, provider_payload.ex, plus any others under apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extensions/.

STEP 2 — For each: rewrite to `@behaviour OctoPi.Coder.Extension` + on_event/3 dispatch, preserving observable behavior. Pattern-match on event_type at top of on_event/3.

STEP 3 — Update each extension's tests to use the new shape; remove macro-specific test scaffolding.

STEP 4 — provider_payload.ex is a known special case (per opi-fin epic notes): takes a log_fn callback, not state. Migrate carefully — it should NOT acquire state-agent semantics during this rewrite.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `grep -rn "use OctoPi\.Coder\.Extension" apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extensions/` returns 0 matches (old macro gone)
- [ ] `grep -rln "@behaviour OctoPi\.Coder\.Extension" apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extensions/` returns one match per migrated extension file
- [ ] Each migrated extension has at least one `def on_event(` definition
- [ ] Each migrated extension's existing tests pass without modification of intent (test bodies may change to match new shape; assertions must still cover same behavior)
- [ ] `mix test` passes
- [ ] Sanity test: load tools.ex into a Session, send an :agent_start event, verify tools were registered with Session (no regression vs old shape)
- [ ] Sanity test: load git_checkpoint.ex, trigger an agent_end, verify a git checkpoint is created

## Dependencies

Blocked by: opi-fin.14, opi-fin.15
title: Migrate coder-side extensions to on_event/3 shape
